messages:
anna: quick feedback from a design pass on the API credentials page. pulling out the main UX/accessibility polish items i think we should fix first :wave: leo: thanks anna — high level first? maria: can you drop the screenshots or mockups here so eng can triage? :eyes: anna: uploaded in the doc but tl;dr: 1) create key flow confuses the verb (Generate vs Create vs Reveal) 2) rotate confirmation modal is wordy and doesn't show exact consequences (which scopes persist?) 3) revoke has no undo affordance or clear last-used metadata 4) empty state CTA and description are weak for new orgs oliver: agree on revive copy. also noticed keyboard focus gets trapped behind the help flyout on small screens — hard to tab to the primary CTA jamal: can you paste the rotate modal copy you saw? i want to check legal-sounding phrases anna: current rotate copy: "Rotating this key will immediately invalidate existing tokens. Any running jobs using this key may fail." feels scary and vague — customers ask "what exactly breaks?" aisha: suggest: "Rotating this key replaces its secret. Previous secrets stop working immediately; integrations using the old secret must be updated. Scopes and settings remain unchanged." short + explicit. :thumbsup: leo: +1 to making it actionable. also add a small callout about webhook/backward-compatibility patterns (e.g., staggered rollout) maria: empty state: current text: "You don't have any API keys yet." CTA: "Create key". propose: "Create an API key to call the Redwood API. You’ll only see the secret once — copy it now or store it in your secret manager." CTA: "Generate API key" — more explicit about reveal behavior jamal: on that reveal behavior, we should surface an inline reminder about copy/paste and masking. People keep leaving the page thinking they'll re-open the secret later. maybe a small checkbox "I stored the secret" to enable the Done button? anna: i worry that a checkbox adds friction for quick dev flows. instead propose an inline helper line + small icon that expands details. default should be simple but clear. we can add an optional confirmation for orgs flagged as high-compliance oliver: accessibility nits: color contrast for the danger badge on rotate is failing 3:1 on the current red on the light bg. Also the rotate modal header doesn't have a role=heading level announced on screen readers — net effect: SR users can't easily tell modal purpose aisha: small aria snippet proposal: ```html

Rotate API key

This replaces the secret. Existing tokens stop working immediately.

``` that ensures SR announces title + description. we should also trap focus and return it to the triggering control maria: linking rotate to scopes — we should explicitly state if scopes/permissions are preserved or if rotation also creates a new key id. customers ask whether they need to re-grant permissions jamal: quick answer from product: rotation preserves key id and scopes; it only replaces the secret string. but we should make that explicit in the UI copy and in the api docs. anna: table layout debate: current columns are Name | Last used | Created | Actions. Proposal: Name | Scopes | Last used | Created | Expires | Actions. the Scopes column helps surface least-privilege issues leo: agree but make scopes collapsible (chips) to avoid clutter. mobile should hide Created by default and collapse Expires into a details row anna: also think we need an affordance for "active sessions" — small tag if the key has recent traffic (last 24h) so people know if rotation will immediately impact running services oliver: for keyboard users, the actions menu currently requires a mouse to open; need a visible focus ring and Enter/Space to toggle the menu. also the menu items should be real buttons not anchors to improve semantics aisha: accessibility todo: add aria-pressed for toggle states, ensure keyboard order matches visual order, use aria-live polite for success/error to announce results without stealing focus maria: copy tweak for revoke confirmation: now: "Are you sure you want to revoke this key?" proposed: "Revoke API key — This will immediately stop anyone from using this key. This action is irreversible." then two buttons: "Revoke key" (destructive) and "Cancel". include last-used timestamp and list of recent projects that used it jamal: legal: mention that logs will show failed requests but we can't map them to calls after revocation — product ok? anna: yes, fine — but make legal phrasing optional via a "More about revocation" expandable panel leo: microinteraction: when someone copies a secret we should show a tooltip that says "Secret copied — it will not be shown again" and a small undo link that opens copy instructions; also consider a clipboard permission fallback flow anna: one oddity: the "Create key" modal defaults to all scopes checked which encourages over-permission. we should default to minimal scopes and surface a "recommended for most apps" grouping maria: i can mock the default checked state and the grouped permission chips by EOD for the next design review anna: accessibility visual: ensure the masked secret reveal has an accessible label like "Reveal secret, currently masked" and that toggling announce via aria-live: "Secret revealed" aisha: also remove icons-only buttons without text unless they have aria-labels — we found one in the header actions that only shows a key icon jamal: next steps: oliver to file the eng tickets for keyboard + focus fixes; maria to push copy+mock updates; leo to adjust table responsive behavior; anna to add the short copy doc for rotate/revoke/empty states leo: pinging @design-bot to create the tickets with our checklist :robot_face: design-bot: Created tickets: PROD-1123 (rotate copy + aria), PROD-1124 (keyboard focus for actions menu), PROD-1125 (empty state copy + CTA update), PROD-1126 (table responsive + scopes column). Links: https://go/redwood/PROD-1123 https://go/redwood/PROD-1124 maria: thanks everyone. i'll drop mocks in Figma and tag eng when ready. :thumbsup: anna: ok let's ship the copy updates first — lower risk, big clarity gain. thanks all! :sparkles:
